text:
maria: FYI seeing intermittent p95 jumps in eu-west-3 during warm-cache churn (approx 03:00-03:20 UTC). NVLink retransmits + egress queue spikes together.

alex: Confirmed. Small set of nodes in rack-12 show both gpu_p95 up and egress_queue_len doubling. Likely many warmups lining up.

jamal: Any single noisy tenant?

maria: No, multiple mid-size tenants. Pattern looks like prefix-gen bursts touching cold KV.

kevin: Trace sample req=tx-warm-9: queued ~100ms at egress proxy; dmesg shows brief pci link recovery.

olga: PromQL to reproduce?

kevin: max_over_time(egress_proxy_queue_len{region="eu-west-3"}[5m]) by (node)
and
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_inference_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le,node))

alex: Mitigation proposal: carve tiny ephemeral "warmup-mini" silos (2 GPUs) and steer warmup traffic there with egress soft-cap (fairshare weight 0.25). Start with header X-Warmup:true from SDK as canary trigger.

jamal: Scheduler change: add AllocationClass mini-warmup-ephemeral with selector gpu_label=warmup-mini, ephemeralTTL=8m, preemptible=false. Pin 2 nodes initially.

kevin: I'll run a replay in staging against mini-silo to compare egress qlen & NVLink counters vs shared.

olga: SRE-bot: create alert warmup-mini-pressure, 3m hold, slack-only.

sre-bot: Alert warmup-mini-pressure created (severity: warning), paging disabled.

kevin: Replay results (staging): egress p95 down ~48%, NVLink retransmit down ~55%, median unchanged. Token/sec on warmup path down ~4% due to shaping. Cost delta small (+~1.5% infra for reserved silos).

maria: Good. Rollout plan: 5% warmup traffic canary for 30m in eu-west-3. Monitor gates: region_egress_p95 > baseline*1.4 OR nvlink_err_rate > 2x OR warmup-mini_q_len > 120 for >2m -> rollback.

alex: Proxy config sketch:
```
route:
  match: header("X-Warmup") == "true"
  pool: warmup-mini
  pool.qos.weight: 0.25
  pool.egress.limit: 50KBps
```

jamal: I'll label two underutilized racks gpu_label=warmup-mini and create the AllocationClass in eu-west-3 staging, then mirror to prod with canary.

olga: I'll file a finance ticket to set a cost cap for the trial and notify support/product about possible transient changes.

maria: Add per-slice egress_p95 and per-route token_rate to console before canary so PMs can validate customer impact. Also add tenant opt-out flag for trial.

kevin: If the proxy shaping isn't enough, we should add tc qdisc rate limiting as node-level fallback.

alex: Runbook for oncall: 1) disable warmup route, 2) scale mini-silo allocation to 0, 3) revert SDK header rollout, 4) escalate with nvlink logs.

jamal: Staging allocation created and replay uploaded to perf jobs. Ready for 5% canary when infra gives go.

maria: Thanks — will schedule canary window and post updates.
